title: superium mayhem!
description: This mod simply adds new ore that can be mined or traded with villagers, its the best ore with overpowerd armor!
body:
# About

 This mod adds new (overpowerd) ore, new multi-multi tool that idk if its possible to trade (ill make it possible) and superium tools

 New Tools; multi-multi tool - the best tool that acts as every tool with sword!, superium pickaxe - the best pickaxe it the entire game! its evem faster than gold and netherite combined! (same as other),superium sword just an normal sword but OVERPOWERD as everything.

 new ore; superium - superium is used to craft everything it this mod it even GLOWS! (i dont know why i do this but yea looks cool right?), superium block - block of that is overpowerd aswell! normal ore block? no! it gives u speed and jump boost effect at level TWO! (and when you try to move on that block it acts like ice)
